meta.name: College Romance
meta.description:
College Romance is a story of three BFF's : Karan, Trippy and Naira ; who fall in love and their ridiculous romantic stories take off.

Not complete. On your server: S1 5/5 | S2 not on server | S3 not on server | S4 not on server

videos.title: The Hint
videos.overview: Naira, Trippy and Karan's college life is full of #YaarPyaarAurBakchodi. Trippy has a new crush, Karan is confused about his relationship and Naira is trying to help them. Will their love life come back on track ?

videos.title: Tommy
videos.overview: Freshers party is coming up. Trippy is convincing Karan and Naira to go to regular party and not a pool party.

videos.title: Paneer Sex Masala
videos.overview: It's time for Naira,Trippy and Karan to take their relationships to the next level. Will it be awkward or fun?

videos.title: Spank Me
videos.overview: Raveena meets her ex boyfriend. Karan's naked picture gets circulated in the college. Bagga gets into a fight. Can it be any worse ?

videos.title: Happily Fucked Up
videos.overview: Trippy is worried about Raveena and her ex. Karan is jealous about Deepika's new date and Naira and Bagga are fighting about his swearing problem.
